title: Humanitarian mission needed in occupied Hola Prystan community, similar to Oleshky operation – local official
summary: The Hola Prystan community needs a humanitarian mission similar to the one carried out in Oleshky.

title: Ukrainian drones to replace Mavics pass testing, best models to be ordered for military
summary: The Brave1 defense innovation cluster, together with Ukraine’s Ministry of Defense, has tested reconnaissance drones of the Mavic type from nine Ukrainian manufacturers to assess whether the aircraft meet the military’s actual needs and the conditions of the modern battlefield.

title: Over 11,000 foreign nationals fighting for Russia killed in Ukraine – Bloomberg
summary: Russian authorities have registered the deaths of more than 11,000 foreigners from nearly 100 countries in the war against Ukraine.
